Class PersistenceManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.persistency.PersistenceManager
public class PersistenceManager extends Object
Manages the persistence lifecycle of active matches.

Keeps track of all running GameManager instances and provides methods to save and delete their state on demand. On shutdown, a final save is performed for every match still in progress so that games can be resumed after a server restarts.

Persistence is delegated to GameStateDAO, which handles the actual reading and writing of JSON save files.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public void register(int matchId, GameManager gameManager)
      Registers a match so that its state can be saved by this manager.
      Parameters:
      matchId - unique identifier of the match
      gameManager - the GameManager instance handling the match

    • unregister

      public void unregister(int matchId)
      Unregisters a completed match and deletes its save file.

      Should be called when a match ends normally so that its persisted state is cleaned up and it is no longer tracked by this manager.

      Parameters:
      matchId - unique identifier of the match to unregister

    • saveNow

      public void saveNow(int matchId, GameManager gameManager)
      Immediately saves the current state of the given match.

      If the match is in the GamePhaseEnum.END_GAME phase, its save file is deleted instead of being updated, since a finished game does not need to be resumed.

      Parameters:
      matchId - unique identifier of the match
      gameManager - the GameManager instance to snapshot

    • buildSnapshot

      public GameSnapshot buildSnapshot(int matchId, GameManager gameManager)
      Builds a GameSnapshot representing the current state of the given match.
      Parameters:
      matchId - unique identifier of the match
      gameManager - the GameManager instance to snapshot
      Returns:
      a snapshot of the current game state; never null

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Saves all active matches on shutdown.

      Should be called when the server is shutting down to ensure that no in-progress match is lost. After this method returns, the manager should not be used further.
